summary: Master financial data analysis with our comprehensive training course. Gain essential skills in data interpretation to drive informed financial decisions.
lede: Financial data analysis training helps finance professionals interpret statements and turn financial information into forecasts and decision-ready reporting. You’ll use Excel formulas and PivotTables to analyze ratios and variances, build driver-based forecasts and basic discounted cash flow models, and communicate findings through dashboards and management commentary.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with financial statements, management reports, and forecasting outputs and need to interpret data with greater confidence.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: basic numeracy, comfort with spreadsheets, and a working knowledge of financial statements. You do not need programming experience, but you should be able to navigate Microsoft Excel and read a basic profit and loss statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement. Advanced topics such as valuation modeling and scenario analysis are taught at an introductory-to-operational level, not as full specialist engineering. Participants should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed; if your organization uses Power BI or similar reporting tools, those can be used for contextual examples, but they are not required for completion.
